name: robot-reinforcement-learning
description: Reinforcement learning for robots: when RL beats imitation or classical control, MDP design (observations, action spaces, control rate, terminated vs truncated), reward design and reward hacking, algorithm choice, massively parallel sim training, safe real-robot RL, and debugging training curves. Use when the user mentions reinforcement learning, RL, PPO, SAC, TD3, GAE, reward function, reward shaping, curriculum, domain randomization, sim-to-real, actuator network, asymmetric actor-critic, teacher-student distillation, rsl_rl, rl_games, skrl, Stable-Baselines3, CleanRL, Brax training, FastTD3, HIL-SERL, SERL, RLPD, DrQ, residual RL, DSRL, RL fine-tuning of a BC, diffusion or VLA policy, time-out bootstrapping, entropy collapse, value loss explosion, NaN during training, or evaluating RL with seeds and IQM. Also for Isaac Lab, mjlab or Playground locomotion and manipulation policies.
